decisions.reason: Fouling detection automation builds directly on the firm's control, monitoring and automation know-how, and it fits its direction toward energy recovery in wastewater heat exchangers, so the firm can interpret early results and refine the product.

A web tool for weir dimensioning draws on core hydraulic engineering knowledge from thousands of projects, costs little to maintain, and supports sales to planners, so it is well absorbed into the existing business.

The fouling detection system pairs hardware with the automation offering and relies on the firm's proprietary product and engineering development base, though it may later be merged with Product A, which leaves some risk of consolidation.
